```python
import requests
from PyPDF2 import PdfReader
import re

# URL of the paper
url = "https://arxiv.org/pdf/2207.01510"

# Download the PDF
response = requests.get(url)
with open("AI_regulation_paper.pdf", "wb") as f:
    f.write(response.content)

# Read the PDF
reader = PdfReader("AI_regulation_paper.pdf")
text = ""
for page in reader.pages:
    text += page.extract_text()

# Use regex to find the figure with three axes and their labels
# This is a simplified example and may need adjustment based on the actual content
matches = re.findall(r'Figure.*?axes.*?label.*?(\w+).*?(\w+).*?(\w+)', text, re.DOTALL)

# Print the matches
print(matches)
```
